purpose: Compress large work logs into decision-relevant evidence so an agent loads the few records that can actually change a conclusion.
loading_rule: load the representative log for that class
follow down to raw evidence only when the summary is disputed or insufficient

cases.phenotype: Mobile users waited roughly 13 seconds for the main first-screen content.

high_information_evidence.experiment: Replace only the first-screen slider with a static lightweight hero while keeping the rest of the page comparable.

cases.overlooked_variable: The first-screen interaction architecture, not hosting alone, dominated perceived loading time.
cases.rejected_explanation: Changing hosting was the primary solution.
cases.decision: Remove the heavy slider from the first screen, rebuild the visual as a lightweight hero, then restore visual rhythm without restoring the slider runtime.
cases.decision_effect: Changed the implementation path from infrastructure-first to front-end-structure-first.

cases.phenotype: A multilingual release was reported complete, but equivalent pillar content existed in only one language.

high_information_evidence.finding: URLs, H1, hreflang and articles existed across languages, but equivalent pillar DOM did not.
high_information_evidence.secondary_modifier: Logged-in WordPress output could differ from anonymous cached output.

cases.overlooked_variable: The release denominator checked language surfaces, but not equivalent rendered content per language.
cases.wrong_inference: Success in one language was generalized to the multilingual ecosystem.
cases.decision: Require per-language anonymous DOM validation and desktop/mobile checks before multilingual completion can pass.
cases.decision_effect: Created a stricter multilingual release gate.

cases.phenotype: The visible product body used updated engineering facts while older FAQ and machine-readable data still exposed obsolete values.

high_information_evidence.finding: One product fact had multiple representations: visible body, FAQ, structured data and language variants.

cases.overlooked_variable: Updating the visible page did not invalidate every derived representation of the same fact.
cases.decision: Make the owner-confirmed registry authoritative and validate all derived representations together.
cases.decision_effect: Added a consistency validator and legacy-value ban checks.

cases.phenotype: Local/public checks looked healthy, but first-party search-console data exposed legacy URL behavior that still needed correction.
cases.overlooked_variable: A local PASS does not guarantee that the search engine sees the same historical URL graph.
cases.decision: Treat first-party search-console evidence as an external reality check and repair unambiguous legacy paths with relevant single-hop redirects.
cases.decision_effect: Search data became an input to engineering decisions, not only a reporting dashboard.

cases.phenotype: A lightweight scroll-reveal interaction existed on an isolated test page but was not part of the production homepage at that checkpoint.
cases.overlooked_variable: An experiment existing in the project can later be misremembered as a released feature.
cases.decision: Record experiment state separately from production state and require explicit release evidence before describing an experiment as shipped.
cases.decision_effect: Prevents later agents from converting project history into false production claims.

cases.phenotype: The human operator and agent disagreed about whether a production-safe structured-data policy should prevent a limited AIO experiment.
cases.human_hypothesis: Use one product as an experimental group: improve visible FAQ and semantic clarity without inventing Offer, price, review or rating fields, then compare later search/AI visibility against unchanged products.
cases.agent_objection: The original objective emphasized zero Rich Results errors and the agent did not expect unsupported schema additions to improve eligibility.
cases.overlooked_variable: Production validation and information-gain experiments optimize different objectives.
cases.decision: Do not roll the idea out site-wide. Preserve it as an isolated, measurable hypothesis.
